# Aapko Kya Lagta Hai

> Aapko Kya Lagta Hai ("what do you think?") is a daily photo-and-question
> voting site for Indian Gen Z. A new debate — one photo, one yes/no-shaped
> question, in English and Hindi — is published every day across six
> categories. Visitors vote 👍 or 👎 with no account required, and see how
> the crowd is split.

## Categories

- Campus & Hostel Life
- Streetwear & Fits
- Street Food & Chai
- Pop Culture & OTT
- Reels & Content
- Startup & Hustle

## Key pages

- [Home](https://aapkokyalagtahai.com/) — today's debates, swipeable feed
- [FAQ](https://aapkokyalagtahai.com/faq) — how voting works, languages, data collection, in plain Q&A form
- [About](https://aapkokyalagtahai.com/about) — what the site is and why it exists
- [Privacy Policy](https://aapkokyalagtahai.com/privacy) — exactly what is and isn't collected (no accounts, no third-party trackers)
- Category pages: `https://aapkokyalagtahai.com/category/<slug>` for each category above (slugs: campus-life, streetwear, street-food, pop-culture, reels-content, startup-hustle)
- Individual debates: `https://aapkokyalagtahai.com/debate/<slug>` — each one is a single photo + question + the current crowd verdict as a percentage, with comments

## Notes for automated readers

- Every debate page's initial HTML includes the current vote split as plain
  text (e.g. "62% of 1,400 said yes") once the debate has at least one
  vote — this does not require any interaction or JavaScript execution.
- Structured data: debate pages carry `DiscussionForumPosting` and
  `QAPage`/`Question`/`Answer` JSON-LD; the FAQ page carries `FAQPage`
  JSON-LD.
- `sitemap.xml` at the site root lists all active debates and is
  regenerated hourly.
- No login, paywall, or personal information is required to read or vote.
